Maya Patel: Heads-up — procurement just pushed one shipment ETA by ~3 days. Need to reconcile canary reservations and allocation. Quick async: who owns GCP node prep, canary slot assignment, and checking for customer reservation overlaps? pinging owners @jon @li @priya

Jon Rivera: On it. I'll own node prep for us-east. ETA to smoke: ~36h after racks in. We still need power/cable mapping from infra. @dan can you confirm racking window?

Li Chen: Canary plan: prefer 2x small A10 slots for early perf tests, then H100 for load. Who can reserve those in staging?

Priya Nair: I can reserve staging slots; need reservation IDs + expected dates. Also we should gate canary on the quantization profile from ML team — @li can you drive that?

Daniel Kim: Racking window confirmed for Friday 09:00-17:00. Power circuits 4-6 assigned. Will upload manifest to #eng-infra shortly. infra-bot: create deploy-plan

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: plan_id=dp-2026-03-17-42. Tasks: preflight -> racking -> cable -> smoke. ETA: Friday start.

Maya Patel: Two asks: (1) Jon/Li — confirm staging reservations by EOD today. (2) Priya/Dan — if power/cable hits >1 change, flag here. We need to avoid double-booking.

Jon Rivera: Reservation done for us-east-small: res-4829. Linking in console now.

Li Chen: Quant profile note: q4_0 shows small perf delta vs q8_0; will test both. Pushed prompt set to eval harness.

Priya Nair: Reserved staging res-stg-77 for 2x A10 starting Thu 22:00 UTC. If racking runs late we should shift to Fri 02:00 — I'm flexible.

Daniel Kim: Manifest uploaded: https://internal.redwood/infra/manifest/3076543210. Cable layout PDF attached in #eng-infra. Ask if you need L2 rack mapping.

Jon Rivera: Quick code-review ping: PR #4215 touches autoscaler config for dedicated clusters — @li @maya please review. We should freeze autoscale policy during canary (set max_scale=1).

Li Chen: I'll review later today. Agree on freeze and max_scale=1 for canary.

Maya Patel: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with SRE to add an automated rollback if latency spikes >50% over baseline in 5m.

sre-bot: Monitoring alert rule created: rule_id=canary-latency-rollback. Trigger: 5m p50 > 1.5x baseline -> rollback.

Priya Nair: One more: sales flagged a customer (cust-ACME) with reserved capacity same week. @maya can you confirm priority? They have reserved slots for next-month runway.

Maya Patel: ACME gets priority for reserved dedicated slots. Canary stays on staging A10s only. Noted and will update sales.

Jon Rivera: OK — holding H100 load tests until Maya confirms post-ACME schedule.

Li Chen: Test matrix I'll run: quant=q4_0/q8_0, batch sizes=[1,4,8], metrics=latency p95/p99 + throughput. Will post results here.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Next check-in tomorrow 10:00. If anyone stalls, drop updates here. Thanks!
